items.summary: Preprint on a hierarchical runtime for navigation agents that manage context across steps.
items.whyItMatters: Niche for now; watch if you build embodied or navigation agents.

items.summary: Preprint proposing a recursive self-improvement loop where a model keeps and revises reflective rulebooks.
items.whyItMatters: Self-improvement claims need replication before you rely on them.

items.summary: Preprint on training multimodal diagnosis agents to weigh the cost of each extra test or image they request.
items.whyItMatters: Relevant mainly to medical AI teams.

items.summary: Preprint reporting that framing supervised fine-tuning data as context reduces forgetting of earlier abilities.
items.whyItMatters: A possible cheap fix if fine-tuning erodes base skills.

items.summary: Preprint applying diffusion language models to agent planning, with a plan-then-patch procedure.
items.whyItMatters: Early look at non-autoregressive planning for agents.

items.summary: Preprint on training a policy that decides how a model adapts itself at test time.
items.whyItMatters: Narrow research; test-time training is still experimental.

items.summary: Preprint on graders that agents co-evolve with and that humans can inspect, aimed at the verifier problem.
items.whyItMatters: Matters if your evals depend on automated graders.

items.summary: Preprint adding visual world modeling to multimodal language models.
items.whyItMatters: Incremental multimodal research.

items.summary: Preprint claiming a 50-million-token memory approach cheaper than recomputing context; the claim comes from the title and is unverified.
items.whyItMatters: Worth checking against your long-context costs only if results hold.

items.summary: Preprint on compressing stored edits so a model can be edited many times with less memory.
items.whyItMatters: Niche, but relevant to teams that patch model facts.

items.summary: Preprint introducing flow-style generative models for binary data.
items.whyItMatters: Narrow subfield.

items.summary: Preprint on generating samples in few steps by iterating in data space.
items.whyItMatters: Small step in fast-sampling research.

items.summary: Preprint on time-series forecasting that links numeric signals with news narratives.
items.whyItMatters: Niche forecasting method.

items.summary: Preprint giving audio-visual language models a 2D floor map for spatial context.
items.whyItMatters: Niche multimodal work.

items.summary: Preprint distilling unified multimodal diffusion language models into few-step generators.
items.whyItMatters: Faster inference for multimodal diffusion models.

items.summary: Preprint on guiding vision-language decoders toward grounded regions by handling attention sinks.
items.whyItMatters: Narrow vision-language research.

items.summary: Preprint comparing pronunciation-aware tokenization for German speech recognition.
items.whyItMatters: Useful only to speech teams working on German.

items.summary: Preprint describing a latent world-action model for humanoid robot control.
items.whyItMatters: Early robotics research; no deployment signal.

items.summary: Preprint using retrieval for sign language translation without gloss annotations.
items.whyItMatters: Niche accessibility research.

items.summary: Preprint on reusing key-value caches in world action models within a staleness bound.
items.whyItMatters: Inference-efficiency idea for robotics models.

items.summary: Preprint on 4-bit weight and activation quantization for multimodal diffusion transformers.
items.whyItMatters: May cut serving cost for image and video generators.

items.summary: Preprint compressing the value cache across layers by exploiting symmetry.
items.whyItMatters: Memory savings for long-context serving, if it holds up.

items.summary: Preprint proposing a four-tensor attention variant for modeling physical scenes.
items.whyItMatters: Speculative architecture work.

items.summary: Preprint releasing language models trained with time-consistent data for scientific text.
items.whyItMatters: Helps avoid leakage in science and tech text tasks.

items.summary: OpenAI customer story saying Sophos shortened threat investigations with its Daybreak product.
items.whyItMatters: Vendor-reported figure; treat as a marketing case study.

items.summary: Preprint on implicit neural representations that combine spatial and frequency features.
items.whyItMatters: Narrow signal-representation research.

items.summary: Controlled study of dynamic-point filtering in ORB-SLAM2 for low-texture synthetic scenes.
items.whyItMatters: Niche SLAM engineering result.

items.summary: Preprint on a seek-then-view reasoning approach for multi-view spatial questions.
items.whyItMatters: Narrow vision research.

items.summary: Preprint on video generation that models physical phases for more plausible dynamics.
items.whyItMatters: Physics realism is a known weak spot in video models.

items.summary: Preprint on detecting and attributing deepfake videos with altered motion.
items.whyItMatters: Relevant to teams building deepfake detection.
